{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.78

|gr1= Interpolation

|gr2= Vectors

|descr= Interpolates vector to target, scaled by distance.
Starts very fast and smoothes out.

|s1= [currentValue, targetValue, delta, interpSpeed] call [[BIS_fnc_interpolateVector]]

|p1= currentValue: [[Array]] - the current value

|p2= targetValue: [[Array]] - the target value

|p3= delta: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) the delta time

|p4= interpSpeed: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) the interpolation speed

|r1= [[Array]] - the interpolated value

|x1= <sqf>[[1,1,1], [20,20,20], 0.2, 0.1] call BIS_fnc_interpolateVector;</sqf>
